ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) ratio across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones are localized on the distal-superior regions of both lobes. A broad, low-intensity black channel originates from the peduncle and bifurcates toward the trailing edge. High-contrast stippled mottling is present along the internal margins of the white pigmentation zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an aperture of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged pixel-amplitude spikes (10-25 pixels) are concentrated on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave trajectory sweeping upward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast textured clusters of light-colored circular pixel groupings are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear disruptions are visible on the high-intensity pigmentation of the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped tissue indentation/notch is visible on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent textured clusters on both lateral distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'torn' profile on the medial-superior boundary of the left lobe near the median notch.
